text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] GPU nodepool g-gpu-prod reporting capacity exhaustion: queue-length=1400, p50 latency /v1/generate = 2.4s, error-rate 5%. Paging @oncall-gpu. https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/ALRT-5002

oncall-gpu: ack. I'm on it. seeing autoscaler events: repeated CreateFleet UnauthorizedOperation. grabbing CA logs now.

sre-eli: tagging in. timeline and customer impact?

oncall-gpu: support -> cs-luke: multiple customers reported timeouts; top affected: DataBarn, ScribeAI. Some batch embedding jobs queued for >20m.

infra-zoe: past infra change added an IAM condition to PassRole to restrict to instance profile tag: {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/role-owner": "infra-team"}}. CA doesn't add that tag when calling PassRole, so calls are denied. also occasional LaunchTemplate version mismatch referencing instance-profile name 'gpu-node-profile-v2' which was removed.

eng-maya: hmm. CA needs iam:PassRole to attach instance profile. But the condition breaks it. we need either a hotfix to relax condition or a CA-side workaround.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for cluster-autoscaler v1.21.0 -> will restart when permissions fixed.

oncall-gpu: quick mitigation options: 1) create temporary nodegroup using older LT that has inline instance-profile (no PassRole needed), 2) patch IAM condition to allow CA role to pass gpu-node-profile, 3) manually attach instance profile to instances after EC2 launch (painful).

cs-luke: customers asking for ETA. holding message to send a brief status update once we have mitigation chosen.

(2m)

infra-zoe: I'm going to add a scoped exception to the IAM condition to allow role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cluster-autoscaler-gpu-role to pass role-tag 'role-owner=infra-team' for now. prepping policy change.

eng-maya: while that's happening, can we toggle routing to reduce load? suggest enabling embedding-rate-limiter and route long-gen to cpu pool.

oncall-gpu: enabling rate limits for non-SLA customers now. pushing rule:
```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "policy": "cpu-fallback-on-queue>500", "max_inflight": 8}
```

(3m)

infra-zoe: policy patch applied. verifying via cloudtrail shows iam:PassRole calls from CA now succeed.

sre-eli: restart CA now?

oncall-gpu: restarting CA deployment.
```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system
kubectl logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --since=2m | tail -n 60
```

(1m)

deploy-bot: rollout observed: 1/2 pods ready -> 2/2 pods ready.

noncall-gpu: CA log now shows: "OK: scaleUp nodegroup g-gpu-prod to 3" and then later "Waiting for instances to register".

eng-maya: checking node join: one node stuck NotReady with message kubelet failing to assume instance profile because LT referenced instance-profile arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/gpu-node-profile-v2 (NotFound).

infra-zoe: I can create the missing instance-profile alias gpu-node-profile-v2 that maps to same underlying role as gpu-node-profile. doing now to avoid reboots.

noncall-gpu: ASG launched 2 instances, some came up Ready, one remained NotReady pending instance-profile fix.

(6m)

infra-zoe: dummy instance-profile gpu-node-profile-v2 created and attached. instance that was NotReady now registers and is Ready. pods scheduling.

sre-eli: model-serving pods scheduling -> green. queue draining: 1400 -> 420 in 10m.

cs-luke: customers reporting partial recovery, ScribeAI confirming some long-gen jobs completed. I'll send interim note offering credit and ETA for postmortem.

product-jordan: did any data plane requests get retried/drop? need to quantify SLA blips for billing adjustments.

eng-maya: we'll extract request logs and compute error windows; initial estimate: 22 minutes degraded, ~12 customers affected with transient timeouts.

noncall-gpu: summary of direct mitigations we performed: 1) applied scoped IAM exception to allow CA PassRole calls 2) created missing instance-profile alias to satisfy LT v2 3) restarted cluster-autoscaler 4) enabled CPU-fallback routing for non-SLA traffic 5) manually scaled ASG to accelerate node creation.

infra-zoe: follow-ups I will own: revert scoped exception to a more robust allow-list in IAM that specifically permits CA to PassRole for gpu-node-profile(-v*), add CI check to detect IAM condition changes that block CA, and add automated LT-version existence check in infra pipeline.

eng-maya: runtime follow-ups: add test in canary that simulates CA scale-up with PassRole, add alert for CA UnauthorizedOperation spikes, and add runbook section for instance-profile missing on LT.

sre-eli: ops follow-ups: update GPU outage runbook to include CPU-fallback gating and CS templated messages, run a game day for this scenario.

cs-luke: CS follow-ups: outreach template created and owners assigned.

product-jordan: business follow-up: estimate SLA hit and credit calc (owner: product-jordan).

(15m after first page)

sre-eli: verification: CA logs clear of UnauthorizedOperation errors for last 10m, LT lookups OK. queue now down to 50, p50 latency back to 220ms.

incident-bot: Incident ALRT-5002 status changed: MITIGATED by oncall-gpu. Duration: 00:18:53.

noncall-gpu: declaring mitigation. will draft full postmortem with timeline. thanks all. :trophy:

product-jordan: putting a note to PMs and customers.

incident-bot: creating incident ticket IT-5002 with owner oncall-gpu.

sre-eli: final note: root cause = overly restrictive IAM condition on iam:PassRole combined with stale LaunchTemplate version referencing deleted instance-profile name. Contributing: no test for this IAM-change-to-CA workflow and LT-version drift.

infra-zoe: opening infra tickets: INFRA-912 (LT-version existence check), INFRA-913 (IAM CI lint), INFRA-914 (instance-profile alias cleanup).

eng-maya: opening runtime ticket: RUNTIME-410 (CA UnauthorizedOperation alert).

cs-luke: sending customer emails now.

product-jordan: great response. closing thread after postmortem draft.
